title: Report totals are the same split or not when Show Unassigned is on
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • {Location-A}'s Shop Supplies Charge is 0%, and nothing else is invoiced at {Location-A} today.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} for {Customer-A} is open and not invoiced; it has one labor line of 2.00 hours at $100.00 an hour and one part sold at $50.00; its one "Sales Representative" reads {Sales-rep-A}; it is ready to invoice.
    For example: {Work-order-1} is S2-40001.
  • Starting screen: {Work-order-1} is open in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Invoice {Work-order-1}.
  2. Open Reports > Sales By Representative.
  3. Set the date range to today.
  4. Turn Show Unassigned on and write down the report total.
  5. Reverse the invoice of {Work-order-1}.
  6. Add the "Sales Representative - Parts" field to {Work-order-1}.
  7. Set "Sales Representative - Parts" to "Unassigned".
  8. Invoice {Work-order-1} again.
  9. Open Reports > Sales By Representative.
  10. Set the date range to today.
  11. Turn Show Unassigned on and read the report total.
  12. Turn Show Unassigned off and read the report total.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the invoice is created.
  • Step 2: the Sales By Representative report opens.
  • Step 3: the report shows today's date range.
  • Step 4: the total is $250.00 (200.00 + 50.00).
  • Step 5: the invoice is reversed.
  • Step 6: the card shows "Sales Representative - Labor" and "Sales Representative - Parts".
  • Step 7: "Sales Representative - Parts" reads "Unassigned".
  • Step 8: the new invoice is created with Labor {Sales-rep-A} and Parts Unassigned.
  • Step 9: the Sales By Representative report opens.
  • Step 10: the report shows today's date range.
  • Step 11: the total is still $250.00: {Sales-rep-A} has a $200.00 Labor row and Unassigned a $50.00 Parts row.
  • Step 12: the total is $200.00; the Unassigned parts side is left out.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11269 (Story 5, Credit each side on the invoice and in Sales By Representative)

  • S5-R14: “With Show Unassigned on, the report's totals are the same whether invoices are split or not. With it off, a side credited to Unassigned is left out of the totals, as Unassigned money is today.”
  • S5-R18: “A side with no representative is credited to Unassigned, which shows when Show Unassigned is on, as today.”
  • Goals: “Every dollar of an invoice is credited to exactly one side, and the report's totals never change because of a split.”
